title: Nourishing Peruvian Matcha Salad
description: A grassy, shattering Peruvian salad that blends matcha, caramelized sweet potato, and festive toppings for a bright, anti‑inflammatory lunch.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions and let it cool to room temperature.
Roast sweet potato cubes at 400°F for 20 minutes until caramelized.
In a small bowl, whisk matcha powder with lime juice until a smooth paste forms.
Add olive oil and honey to the matcha mixture and whisk until the dressing emulsifies.
Toss the mixed greens in the dressing to coat evenly.
Add the cooked quinoa, roasted sweet potato, diced bell pepper, and avocado slices to the greens.
Sprinkle toasted quinoa seeds over the salad.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Gently toss the salad again to combine all ingredients.
Serve immediately and enjoy the festive crunch of flavors.
